Applied.description: Whether the frame applied an effect its settings ask for.

CellStats.description: World streaming's state after the last extraction.

pending.description: Cells within range still waiting to load.

rows.description:
Rows of the clouds' dome this frame marched: all of them on exact
frames, a slice on ordinary ones, none without clouds.

view_blocks.description:
Blocks of the view whose clouds this frame marched: none without
clouds or with their march in the view off.

CullingStats.description: What GPU culling ran and left undrawn.

active.description:
Whether this GPU-presented display frame ran it, without an instance
budget (occlusion culling draws in two phases around its test).

instances.description:
Visible instances it left undrawn (occluded, or covering no pixel
center), read back with the visible count; `None` otherwise.

stamps.description: Stamps this frame pressed into the map around the camera.

texels.description:
The map's texels along a side: 0 while off, fewer than the settings'
where the device's buffers cannot hold them.

dropped_impostors.description:
Opaque draw groups that qualified for impostors but draw their meshes
because a budget or the GPU's texture array layers left them none.

impostor_instances.description: Instances drawn as impostors, read back like `lod0_instances`.

lod0_instances.description:
GPU-culled frames with levels of detail: instances drawn as their
mesh, read back with the visible count; `None` otherwise.

lod1_instances.description:
Instances drawn as their mesh's first simplification, read back like
`lod0_instances`.

lod2_instances.description:
Instances drawn as their mesh's second simplification, read back like
`lod0_instances`.

Drawn.description: What a feature drew, and what a budget or the GPU's bindings left out.

dropped.description: Items a budget or the GPU's bindings left out.

invalid.description: Items breaking their rules, which no frame draws.

blades.description: Blades the last read-back frame drew.

dropped.description: Blades past the capacity or budget, which dropped.

reach.description: Meters from the eye ground cover reached this frame, rounded.

tiers.description: The most tiers it grew in: the radius's and doublings past it.

JobStats.description: Workers, their jobs and the host's output cache.

cache_hits.description: Outputs the host's cache handed back instead of running their jobs.

cache_mismatches.description: Verifying, cached outputs differing from a fresh run.

running.description: Jobs handed out and not done.

cluster_overflow.description:
Cluster entries beyond the clusters' budget or the storage still
growing, read back like `visible`.

dropped.description: Usable lights beyond the budget or without a valid pose.

invalid.description: Lights breaking their rules, which no frame draws.

shaded.description: Local lights the frame shaded within the budget.

visible.description:
Lights that reached a view cluster, read back a few frames late;
`None` before the first read-back or without lights.

NavStats.description:
What navigation did at the last fixed tick: agents, and
those searching, walking, arrived and unable to reach their
destination; and the samples of search work the tick did.

searching.description: Agents whose walk is being searched.

unreachable.description: Agents whose destination no walk reaches.

work.description: Samples of search work the tick did.

OccupancyStats.description: The occupancy map around the camera.

redraws.description:
Times the map was drawn: it follows the camera in steps and redraws
when objects change.

dropped.description: Probes a budget or the GPU's texture array layers left out.

ready.description: Probes surfaces could reflect this frame.

active.description: Whether the sun cast shadows this frame.

draws.description:
Indexed draws into the shadow maps, beside the camera pass's
`draw_calls`.

kept_casters.description:
Casters the kept map drew, read back like the near map's: redraws
only.

kept_redraw.description:
The kept map's redraw: 0 none, 1 a rectangle of dirty tiles, 2 the
whole map (every still caster).

level_casters.description: Casters the kept levels drew, read back like the near map's.

levels_pending.description: Kept-level tiles no level holds yet: lookups read coarser maps there.

moving_casters.description:
Casters the moving map drew, read back like the near map's: in a
settled scene, the moving renderables.

near_casters.description:
Casters the near map drew, read back a few frames late; `None` before
the first read-back.

tables.description:
Tables this frame built: two when its air changed, one more when the
sun, the camera's height or the air changed; none without the sky.

dropped_materials.description:
Surface materials past the palette's capacity, or whose maps the
shared arrays cannot hold (block compressed, or sized unlike the first
material's), which show a plain color instead.

dropped_tiles.description: Tiles the tile budget or the device's texture array layers dropped.

dropped_vt_pages.description:
Virtual texture pages asked for with no slot left under its budget or
the device's texture array layers.

fallback_patches.description: Patches standing in for finer levels not resident yet.

gpu_controls.description: Tiles the GPU gave control values this frame.

horizons.description: Terrains casting long sun shadows through horizon maps.

placed_far_objects.description:
Of those, objects standing far away, which hide where the tiles
holding them instead are resident.

placed_impostors.description:
Placed objects' impostors baked, which the camera draws far away and
shadow maps cast as cards; counted in `level_of_detail.impostors` too.

placed_objects.description:
Objects placement layers stand on resident level-0 tiles, each culled
on the GPU every frame.

sky_maps.description: Terrains whose sky visibility maps are built.

sky_rows.description: Rows of sky visibility maps this frame built.

unplaced_tiles.description:
Resident tiles lacking objects their levels place with nothing
under way to place them: none unless streaming lost track of them.

vt_bakes.description: Virtual texture pages baked this frame (absent or stale).

vt_evictions.description: Virtual texture pages evicted for others this frame.

vt_missing.description:
Virtual texture pages asked for but absent, in the last feedback read
back.

vt_slots.description: Pages the runtime virtual texture's sheets hold.

VirtualGeometryStats.description: Virtual geometry, read back a few frames late.

dropped.description: Cluster selections dropped while their storage grew.

dropped_pages.description:
Wanted pages (with arrivals since) that found no room under the
budget or the device's limits.

missing_pages.description:
Pages the last read-back frame wanted and lacked: 0 once its view had
all the detail it asked for.

occluded_clusters.description: The camera's clusters occlusion culling left undrawn.

visibility_buffer.description:
Whether the visibility buffer resolved the camera's virtual geometry
rather than drawing it forward.

chunks.description: Chunks of lakes' and rivers' ribbons drawn.

description:
CPU observations from the last submitted frame and the renderer's report
of it. Render time is not GPU time.

culled_instances.description: Valid instances culling proved outside the view.

draw_calls.description:
Draw commands of the camera's mesh passes, each counted once however
many occlusion phases issue it: each opaque mesh group's, one per
level of detail on GPU-presented frames, the impostors', virtual
geometry's forward bins and the transparent groups'. `shadows.draws`
counts the shadow maps'.

dropped_instances.description: Visible instances the instance budget left undrawn.

dropped_seconds.description: Total simulation time discarded by the fixed-step budget in this session.

extraction_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent extracting the render snapshot.

fixed_steps.description: Fixed simulation ticks this frame ran.

frame.description: The frame these stats describe, as `FrameTime::frame` counts it.

instances.description:
Number of mesh instances submitted (before GPU clipping). GPU-culled
frames report the read-back visible count limited by the instance
budget, or the budgeted candidate count before any read-back.

invalid_transforms.description:
Renderable entities skipped because their derived transform is
invalid.

jobs.description: The host's workers and their jobs, read when the stats are.

loading.description:
Whether terrains have yet to load the camera's view whole, read
when the stats are: hosts keep preparing meanwhile.

mesh_upload_bytes.description: Vertex/index bytes initialized for meshes first seen this frame.

missing_assets.description:
Renderable entities skipped because a mesh, material, or texture is
absent.

navigation.description: Navigation agents at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

pipelines_compiling.description:
Whether the GPU may still be compiling pipelines earlier frames
created, read when the stats are.

pipelines_created.description:
Pipelines this frame created: 0 once everything the scene draws is
compiled.

read_back_age.description:
GPU-culled frames only: how many GPU-presented frames late the counts
read back with the visible count (`instances`, `triangles`,
`occlusion_culling`, `subpixel_culling` and `level_of_detail`'s
instances) are, 1 when they arrived as soon as they could, more while
the GPU falls behind; `None` before the first read-back. A check that
changed what they count presents until this is below the frames it
presented since.

render_candidates.description: Every entity carrying a mesh, before transform and asset checks.

render_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent preparing and submitting GPU work.

render_passes.description: The passes this frame ran, in order.

resident_mesh_bytes.description: Vertex/index bytes retained on the GPU after this frame.

resident_meshes.description: Number of distinct meshes retained on the GPU.

resident_texture_bytes.description: Asset texel bytes retained on the GPU after this frame.

resident_textures.description: Number of asset textures retained on the GPU, excluding renderer white.

simulation_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent in fixed and variable simulation.

texture_upload_bytes.description: Texel bytes uploaded for textures first seen this frame.

tick.description:
The last fixed tick that frame completed, as `FixedTime::tick`
counts it.

triangles.description:
Triangles the camera's mesh draws submitted, at their levels of
detail and impostors' two each: exact on CPU-prepared frames, read
back with the visible count on GPU-culled ones. Virtual geometry
counts its own in `virtual_geometry.triangles`.

upload_bytes.description:
Actual bytes uploaded or initialized: changed camera/instances and new
assets. An unchanged rendered frame can submit draws with zero upload
bytes. Excludes renderer startup resources such as the four-byte white
texture.

visible_instances.description:
Valid instances surviving culling, before the instance budget;
GPU-culled frames report the latest read-back count.

title: FrameStats
